title: Typed HTTP APIs with FastAPI

spans.text: FastAPI is an ASGI web framework that uses Python type annotations to build HTTP endpoints and JSON APIs. Pydantic models validate request and response data, path/query/body parameters reach endpoint functions, and OpenAPI schemas can produce interactive documentation. FastAPI is server-side infrastructure called by other programs over a network, not a desktop GUI.

spans.code: The server defines POST /items. A valid request returns JSON such as {"name":"pen","price":1.5}; starting the server itself does not call the endpoint.

spans.text: The Pydantic model validates the JSON body; FastAPI can derive an OpenAPI description and interactive API docs from it.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Include status codes, validation, and error responses in the API contract; interactive docs do not replace authentication or authorization.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Production requires explicit HTTPS, authentication/authorization, secret management, rate limits, and request-size limits.
